plan.notes: Source: https://acu.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Cybersecurity-BS.pdf (official ACU Online degree plan, 2026-2027 Academic Year, College of Leadership and Professional Studies, 100% ONLINE, 120 credit hours). Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30. Caveats: (1) ACU's PDF mislabels the interior header as 'BACHELOR OF SCIENCE IN CRIMINAL JUSTICE' on pages 2-3; the content is the Cybersecurity curriculum (cover and course prefixes CSO/ITA/ITO/ITC confirm). (2) Mathematics lists 'MATO 131* OR MATH 185*' (*May be used to satisfy University Requirements); modeled here as a gen-ed math choice slot (options MATO 131 / MATH 185), not counted in major hours. (3) Major = 19 courses (57 hrs); electives 9 hrs; gen-ed 54 hrs; 57+9+54=120. (4) Semester placement is a recommended sequence (100s->400s); the PDF does not publish a semester-by-semester layout. No course prerequisites are stated in the PDF.
